allowed_actions: read fresh Legacy ledger, duplication map and negative knowledge before ideation
inspect admissible public primary documents and event rules
map event clock, causal mechanism, eligibility, confounders and falsification scope
persist at most one frozen CandidateHypothesis and exactly one VALIDATION handoff, or persist NO_CANDIDATE

inputs.objective: Find exactly one causally distinct event/document mechanism using admissible public primary or documentary evidence, screen Legacy before freeze, actively seek disconfirmation, and freeze at most one CandidateHypothesis without reading candidate returns or future outcomes.

success_condition: One Legacy-screened, causally distinct event/document CandidateHypothesis is frozen and handed to independent validation, or a durable NO_CANDIDATE result is persisted.
